notes: goodwillChanges: releasing a prisoner of a faction gives +12 with it (recalled); a gift gives 1 goodwill per 40 silver of market value (recalled); a visitor killed in the colony costs -25 and an executed prisoner -10 with its faction (both ours). Goodwill runs from -100 to 100; at -75 or less a faction is hostile and at 75 or more an ally (recalled). Goodwill drifts back toward the faction's starting middle slowly; the rate is a placeholder. A faction with permanentEnemy never leaves -100.
